capabilities: Render pasted AI conversations inside aicard fenced code blocks
Isolate the card's markdown from the surrounding note structure
Split conversation turns into user/AI bubbles with a source tag
Insert or wrap AI chat blocks via a command and hotkey
Edit conversation text and source model in place
disambiguation: It does not call any AI model or generate content; it only displays and archives conversations you paste yourself.
extras: Bilingual documentation (English and Chinese). README warns that in Live Preview very long blocks may need scrolling near the block's end to trigger rendering, and recommends Reading view for archived conversations. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author sees AI conversations becoming content worth saving like articles and web notes, but direct pasting breaks formatting, stretches notes, and flattens the dialogue.
problem: Pasting AI chat replies directly into a note scrambles the note's own headings, lists and code fences, and loses the back-and-forth dialogue structure.
summary: Renders pasted AI conversations as scrollable, format-safe cards whose markdown stays contained and never leaks into the note.
